pages.title: Making Angmallen
pages.text: Make this alloy in an Alloyer:$(br2)1 Gold Ingot + 1 Iron Ingot = 2 Angmallen$(br2)1 Gold Dust + 1 Iron Dust = 2 Angmallen

pages.title: Alloying Notes
pages.text: Supply furnace fuel and the complete ingredient amounts. Most alloy inputs accept ingots or dusts; the Angmallen fallback uses matching forms. Loaded recipes can change these stock equations.

pages.title: Default Tool Stats
pages.text: Durability: 164 uses.$(br)Harvest level: 2.$(br)Mining efficiency: 7.2.$(br)Material damage bonus: 2.7.$(br)Enchantability: 32.$(br2)These are the supplied material values. The item type, enchantments, and active traits affect final performance.
